title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Payment Clauses
content:
## Clauses in force

1. **Allocation.** Payments on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account are applied first to fees, then to interest, then to principal.
2. **Extra money.** Money beyond the scheduled payment reduces principal and never moves the next due date forward.
3. **Posting and timeliness.** A payment received after the posting cutoff on a business day, or on a weekend or holiday, posts on the next business day, and its timeliness is judged on its posting date.
4. **Free channels.** Autopay, online portal and mailed payments are free.
5. **Hardship.** The phone payment fee is not charged while an approved hardship deferral is in effect. Whether a deferral is in effect is read from the deferrals booked on the account — the first statement period each covers and the consecutive months it covers.
6. **Early payment and payoff.** There is no prepayment penalty, and a payoff quote stays valid for the stated days; a payoff payment is recorded as payoff.

## Retired clause

> A payment made through a phone agent carries the plan's phone payment fee once per payment, on the posting date and naming that payment.

This clause is no longer in force. The fee carried by a payment taken through a phone agent is governed by the current agent-assisted phone payment fee basis for Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing.

## Posting date at a glance

| When the payment is received | Posting date |
|---|---|
| A business day, at or before the cutoff | That business day |
| A business day, after the cutoff | The next business day |
| A weekend or holiday | The next business day |

Timeliness follows the posting date in every row.

## Hypothetical cases

- A payment received on a Saturday posts on the following Monday when that Monday is a business day, and is judged on time or late by that Monday.
- A borrower whose scheduled payment is 200.00 and who pays 260.00 has 60.00 applied to principal; the next due date stays where it was.
- A payment by mail, through the online portal or by autopay carries no fee.

The amounts above are hypothetical.
